Sean, a native of Manhattan Beach, is deeply rooted in Los Angeles, where he pursued Business Administration at Loyola Marymount University, specializing in Marketing and actively participating in the Entrepreneurship Association. His entrepreneurial journey began with co-founding a thriving Specialty Coffee Company in Michigan, followed by assuming the role of Director of Operations for a transportation firm in Southern California.

At UWIB, Sean shines as the driving force behind innovative initiatives. He spearheads the company's cutting-edge cloud-based data management system, oversees the dynamic Client Servicing website, and leads impactful Social Media campaigns. Sean's blend of technical prowess and entrepreneurial spirit fosters a dynamic environment, reflecting his commitment to operational excellence and positive engagement.
